evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; P null throughout, although the growth stage requires it
Temperature follows the ramp closely; a brief 760.1 °C overshoot at growth start settled to 750±0.3 °C
Stable at about 45% during growth, which fits a normal hold
Ar holds at 100 sccm setpoint within ±1.2
O2 is 3–7 ppm after purge, so no sign of air getting in

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure reading from an independent gauge or a manual check. It would rule out an exhaust blockage or pressure excursion, which O2 and flow alone cannot show. Characterization of the sample is also still missing.
